info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers Timezone APIs API
Convert a timestamp from one timezone to another using any supported location identifier

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: time
params.description: Time to convert in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Omit to convert the current time.

params.name: tz_from
params.description: Source timezone name in IANA format (e.g., Asia/Kolkata) to convert from.

params.name: tz_to
params.description: Target timezone name in IANA format (e.g., America/New_York) to convert to.

params.name: lat_from
params.description: Latitude of source location for coordinate-based conversion.

params.name: long_from
params.description: Longitude of source location for coordinate-based conversion.

params.name: lat_to
params.description: Latitude of target location for coordinate-based conversion.

params.name: long_to
params.description: Longitude of target location for coordinate-based conversion.

params.name: location_from
params.description: Source location address (city and country) for address-based conversion.

params.name: location_to
params.description: Target location address (city and country) for address-based conversion.

params.name: iata_from
params.description: Source IATA airport code (3-letter, e.g., JFK) for airport-based conversion.

params.name: iata_to
params.description: Target IATA airport code (3-letter) for airport-based conversion.

params.name: icao_from
params.description: Source ICAO airport code (4-letter, e.g., KJFK) for airport-based conversion.

params.name: icao_to
params.description: Target ICAO airport code (4-letter) for airport-based conversion.

params.name: locode_from
params.description: Source UN/LOCODE (5-letter) for location code-based conversion.

params.name: locode_to
params.description: Target UN/LOCODE (5-letter) for location code-based conversion.

items.docs: Convert a given time from one timezone to another using timezone names, GPS coordinates, location addresses, IATA/ICAO airport codes, or UN/LOCODEs.

info.name: Retrieve current time, date, and timezone information for any location identifier

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

params.name: ip
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to extract timezone information.

params.name: tz
params.description: Timezone name in IANA format (e.g., Asia/Kolkata) to retrieve information directly.

params.name: location
params.description: Location string (preferably city and country) to extract timezone.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude for geolocation-based timezone lookup. Only time_zone is returned for this mode; no location object is included.

params.name: long
params.description: Longitude for geolocation-based timezone lookup. Only time_zone is returned for this mode; no location object is included.

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language for location fields. Default: en.

params.name: iata_code
params.description: 3-letter IATA airport code (e.g., LHR) to extract timezone.

params.name: icao_code
params.description: 4-letter ICAO airport code (e.g., KJFK) to extract timezone.

params.name: lo_code
params.description: 5-letter UN/LOCODE city code to extract timezone.

items.docs: Get current time, date, and timezone details by specifying a timezone name, location address, GPS coordinates, IP address, IATA/ICAO airport code, UN/LOCODE, or use the client IP if no parameter is provided.
